main.description: Get an HLS CMAF playlist for a video. Returns a master playlist if no track is specified, or a media playlist for the given track. Supports arbitrary time range queries for DVR and VOD.

rkey.description: Record key of the place.stream.video record.

track.description: Track ID for a media playlist. Omit for the master playlist.

start.description: Start time in nanoseconds from the beginning of the video. Defaults to 0.

end.description: End time in nanoseconds. Omit for a live EVENT playlist that extends to the present.

errors.name: VideoNotFound
errors.description: No video record found for this DID and rkey.
